slogans.note: Used twice across posts — the closest thing the org has to a slogan.
Her phrasing of the same line.

slogans.text: When you put us all together, we aren't that rare! There is strength in numbers.
Together, we can make rare impossible to ignore.
Together, we are stronger. And together, we can drive the change that is so urgently needed.
Ontario, we can do better than this. We have to.
Every rare disease journey is unique, but no one should have to navigate it alone.
No Canadian should have to fight harder for healthcare simply because their condition is rare.
This is just the beginning. We will continue building this movement of 1.3 million Ontarians.
Next year, we may need a bigger room.
Rare disease journeys are often lifelong, but no one should have to navigate them alone.

missionStatements.text: Registered not-for-profit organization advocating for those with rare diseases.
This is what drives the creation of the newly formed Ontario Rare Action Group – to unite and amplify rare disease voices across Ontario.

hallelujahSeries.note: Seven frames from one carousel, each naming a systemic failure by describing its absence. Punchy, specific, and in the community's own register — strong raw material for the Challenges page.
frames: Treatment access without entering your villain era… hallelujah
Not needing a 42-step process to access one medication… hallelujah
Families no longer needing to “circle back” seventeen times to keep their child alive… hallelujah
Not having to beg for access every time a new treatment is discovered… hallelujah
Watching families finally feel heard in Ontario… hallelujah
Rare disease patients not having to become part-time lawyers just to access treatment… hallelujah
Parents finally being allowed to just be parents instead of full-time case managers… hallelujah
